faq.question: Is boarding pass allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Boarding Pass is allowed in carry-on luggage. Boarding passes must be carried in hand luggage or on your phone. Do not check your boarding pass since you must present it to TSA officers and gate agents.

faq.question: Can you pack boarding pass in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Boarding Pass is allowed in checked bags.
